# excel-normalizer

> Normalize messy Excel sheets with multi-row headers and merged cells into clean tables, with zip-bomb limits and CSV injection escaping Python package `trysac-excel-normalizer`, import name `excel_normalizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
